hero.subtitle: Online menu, fast delivery, table reservations and QR ordering right at your table. One digital platform for the whole network of 9+ locations.

features.title: Everything for a comfortable order
features.subtitle: One platform brings together menu, delivery, reservations and loyalty — on the web, in the mobile app and on Telegram.

menu.title: Smart online menu
menu.text: Photo, ingredients, calories, macros, allergens, weight and cooking time — for every dish.

delivery.title: Fast delivery
delivery.text: Automatic order distribution, courier GPS and precise arrival time on the map.

booking.title: Table reservations
booking.text: Choose a location, a zone — hall, terrace or VIP, the date, the time and pre-order dishes.

qr.title: QR ordering at the table
qr.text: Scan the QR on your table — open the menu, order and pay the bill without waiting.

loyalty.title: Loyalty program
loyalty.text: Cashback, bonuses and birthday gifts across Bronze, Silver, Gold and Platinum tiers.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.text: Order and reservation status in real time — push, SMS and Telegram.

menu.title: More than 200 oriental dishes
menu.subtitle: Breakfasts, soups, pilaf, manti, kebabs, Kyrgyz cuisine, desserts and drinks — all made from fresh ingredients every day.

orderTypes.title: Three convenient ways
orderTypes.subtitle: Choose a format, pay however you like and get your favorite dishes with no extra steps.

delivery.title: Delivery
delivery.text: We'll bring your hot order across the city with courier tracking on the map.

pickup.title: Pickup
pickup.text: We'll have your order ready for your arrival — no queue, no waiting.

dineIn.title: Order at the table
dineIn.text: Order at your table via QR code and pay the bill from your smartphone.

payment.title: Pay however you like
payment.subtitle: Online, by card, in cash or by QR at the restaurant

booking.title: Book a table in a minute
booking.subtitle: Pick a location, a zone and a time, set the number of guests and pre-order dishes if you like. Confirmation arrives via SMS and Telegram.

loyalty.title: The more often you visit — the more you save
loyalty.subtitle: Earn cashback and bonuses, get discounts and birthday gifts, and invite friends through the referral program.

referral.text: — and you'll both get bonuses on your first order.

branches.title: 9+ locations near you
branches.subtitle: The Mubarak chaikhana network is growing across Kyrgyzstan. Find the nearest location on the map — with address, opening hours and directions.

appPromo.title: Mubarak always at hand
appPromo.subtitle: Install the app without the App Store, straight from your browser. Order, book and collect bonuses from your smartphone — and receive orders via the Telegram bot.
perks: QR ordering and payment right at the table

cta.title: Ready to taste Mubarak?
cta.subtitle: Place your first order online and get bonuses on your loyalty account. We'll deliver it hot in 30 minutes.
